sentences.text: During the night, the ironing room registered a warmth with no source between 02:00 and 06:00.
The observed temperature was 22.4 °C, which is higher than the expected range of 20.8 °C to 21.6 °C.
This indicates that the temperature rose above the predicted 21.2 °C during that time frame.
Maybe this increase was caused by a simple external factor, such as a change in the house's ventilation or insulation.
